fusions.name: Bite on Arrival
fusions.desc: Bounds you to a target up to 7 tiles away; the cut deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Host to Host
fusions.desc: Flings a crescent that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 70% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Ten Hops
fusions.desc: You leap 3 tiles and gain 20% attack speed for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood Meal
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
